unreadable_items.why: White spine behind the shelf upright, between Kreutzer and the Erato Rostropovich case. Only a fragment like 029-2 is visible.
One jewel case is almost entirely hidden by the shelf upright between Magic Moments and Keith Jarrett Standards.
Several further DG jewel cases on this same shelf are visible between the titles listed, but the frame is too tight or duplicated with 130901049 to separate them without inventing catalogue numbers.

About 15 thin LP sleeves in the middle of the stack, between the Beethoven sonata box and Bach Weihnachts-Oratorium, are angled and too small to read one by one. A few fragments (Georges Onslow, VMS 1023, Philips Festivo, Jean Christian Michel) were not clear enough to make rows.
Several thin LP spines between Der Feuervogel and the Brahms violin concerto are only partly in focus (including a Geistliche Musik spine). They were not given rows.
One narrow spine between the Bach mass and Supertramp is turned away. Not read.
